(1)grub dbang pad+ma nor bu sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus bzhugs so/ /theg dgu'i chos tshul gangs ri lhun po'i rtser/ /zung 'jug la

tei:div.tei:p: (1)grub dbang pad+ma nor bu sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar mdor bsdus bzhugs so// theg dgu'i chos tshul gangs ri lhun po'i rtser// zung 'jug lta bas lta dman zil gnon zhing*// grub pa'i rgyal thabs 'dzin pa'i gdong lnga pa// snga 'gyur rig 'dzin rgya mtsho rgyal gyur cig gangs ldan gyi ljongs su 'jam pa'i rdo rje mi rje'i tshul du zhugs pa lha btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi thugs bskyed gser gyi shing rtas drangs pa'i che ba drug ldan snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa'i ring lugs ji snyed cig mchis pa las bar skabs su grags che ba stod na rdor smin/ bar na zhe rdzogs/ smad na kaḥdapal zhes yongs su grags pa'i nang tshan/ dpal yul rnam rgyal byang chub chos gling du rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab nas bzung gdan rabs gser ri'i phreng ba tshar du dngar ba rim par byon pa las/ gdan rabs gsum pa 'grub dbang pad+ma nor bu ni/ rat+na'i gter lung las/ kaḥthog lho ru nor bu'i ming can 'byung*/ zhes sogs gter (2)kha du ma nas gsal ba ltar/ rab drag sa lug la 'khrungs/ paṇa chen bī ma saladang*/ 'ja' tshon snying po'i sprul par zhal gyis bzhes shing*/ gter chen mi 'gyur rdo rje dang*/ rig 'dzin kun bzang shes rab/ pad+ma lhun grub rgya mtsho sogs kyi dngos slob tu gyur cing mdo sgyu sems gsum/ bka' dgongs sogs snga 'gyur bka' gter gces rgu'i dbang lung gdams pa'i mdzod mdzin cing*/ grub pa'i nyams rtsal rdzogs shing snang bzhi mthar phyin nas mkhas tshul gsum gyi nyi mas rgyal bstan pad tshal skyong bzhin dgung grangs don dgur bzhugs pa yin la/ de'i yang srid gdan rabs dgu pa/ sku phreng gnyis pa/ 7grub dbang rin po che 7pad+ma kun bzang bstan 'jin nor bu ni rje chos kyi nyi ma'i mnal lam du gsal ba ltar/ grub dbang sku gong ma gshegs khar nyid kyi gzim spyil rtsar shug sdong yod pa 'di la shug 'bras chags 'ong dus 'dir nga'i skye ba zhig gdan sa 'dir 'ong zhes gsungs pa ltar shug sdong la 'bras bu byung ba dus 'grigs dang skyes chen tshad ldan du mas ngos 'dzin (3)gnang ba nyid rab tshes me phag lor mtshan/

dpe'i pad+mo gsar du bzhad cing*/ de'ang mkhan chen pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis lung bstan pa ltar na/ sprul gzhi phyag na rdo rje/ bod kyi chos blon mgar/ rgyal sras dam 'dzin lha rje/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ gter chen sangs rgyas gling pa/ grub dbang pad+ma nor bu/ rdo grub chen kun bzang gzhan phan/ de'i yang srid phun tshogs 'byung gnas sogs kyi skye ba yin pa nyid kyi zhal gsungs tshig bcad du gsal zhing*/ dgung grangs bdun par dpal yul gdan sar spyan drangs/ gser khrir mnga' gsol zhing dgung lo dgu'i skabs gu ru rin po che zhal gzigs/ rje chos kyi nyi ma las rab tu byung*/ mtshan pad+ma kun bzang bstan 'dzin nor bu gsol/ rat+na dang gnam chos sogs kyi smin grol dang*/ dgongs 'dus/ bka' brgyad/ 'ja' tshon/ kar gling zhi khro sogs dpal yul ba'i zab chos rnams kyi rgyun yod do cog dang*/ bka' ma 'dus pa (4)mdo dbang khams dbus gnyis ka'i rgyun yod pa rnams gsan cing*/ gzhan yang dpal spungs bla ma bkra 'phel las bka' 'gyur/ mkhan rgyal mtshan 'od zer las gter mdzod smin grol rgyab rten dang bcas pa dang*/ mkhan rin po che kun dpal/ mkhan chen ngag dga' sogs las/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs brgya phrag nye bar gsan bsam gyi dpyad pas gtan la phab/ kaḥthog si tu rin po che chos kyi rgya mtsho las gdams mdzod dang*/ gter snying gi skor mang po dang*/ khyad par du nyid kyi rigs bdag mkhan chen ngag gi dbang po las zhi 'tsho'i sdom rgyun las bsnyen par rdzogs/ mtshan thub bstan chos kyi glang por gsol zhing 'dul ba'i gnang bkag gi gnas la mig 'bras ltar gnang bas phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyod gtsang*/ rdzogs chen snyan brgyud kyi khrid btab pas theg mchog rdo rje snying po'i dgongs pa'i rtsal rdzogs/ ka dag rig stong rjen pa'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ 'od gsal thod rgal gyi nyams snang (5)gong du 'phel ba'i mngon rtags brnyes/

dgung grangs bco brgyad skor/ rgya phu brag dkar du 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che'i zhal mjal/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems pa'i sku rten des dbang rdzas thams cad kyi go chod mdzad de/ 'jam dpal zhi drag gi dbang rtsal zhing byin gyis brlabs/ dpal spungs ri khrod du 'jam mgon rin po che'i mdun nas/ mchog gling thugs sgrub dbang gsan/ phyin chad dbang lung spel dgos pa'i bslab ston rtsal/ gzhan yang thun mong gi rig gnas gso ba rig pa/ kā la pā/ sdeb sbyor/ rtsis skar nag skor/ sa yi dpyad pa/ snyan ngag sogs la sbyangs pa tshad du phyin/ dpal yul rang lugs kyi dkyil 'khor lag len gdangs dbyangs sogs gsar du yi ger bkod/ kaḥthog dbu mdzad sogs las khams dbus gnyis ka'i smin lugs gdangs dbyangs lag len legs par sbyangs pas/ dbu mdzad la sus kyang 'gran du med cing*/ mdor na mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par thams cad mkhyen (6)pa'i gnas la dbang bsgyur/ dam pa'i tshul dgu'i yon tan gyi mdzod 'dzin cing rgyal bstan bshad sgrub nyi zla zung gis skyong ba'i dgongs pas rab tshes chu khyi lor dpal yul bshad grwa lnga bcu tham pa gsar du btsugs/ snying thig gi chos bka' gtsang mar 'dzin pa go 'jo sbra nag dgon gsar du btab/ dbu 'dzin du khang nang sprul sku bsko bzhag gnang*/ bsam 'grub gzhung du nyid kyi dngos slob mkhan karma bkra shis la zhal bkod gnang bar ri khrod dgon du bshad sgrub gnyis ldan can snying thig rang lugs kyi dgon sde grwa tshang ngo mtshar ba btsugs/ brda gor dpal 'dus kyis mtshon pa'i snying thig cha tshang sgrub chen dang sgrub mchod cho ga rdzogs par gsar du btsugs/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang sku gsung thugs rten dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs gnang ba sogs rnam thar rgyas pa gdan rabs las gsal/ dgung grangs zhe drug rab rgyal chu sprel nag pa zla ba'i tshes gsum la mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang gi chos (7)sgar snyan shul du phebs nas dgongs pa zhi dbyings su gzims pa'i tshul bstan/

'di yis gsung brtsom mdo sngags gzhung 'grel chog khrigs zin bris sogs pod bcur longs pa yod skad kyang*/ da lta'i pod phar phyin grangs ldan 'di nyid 'bad pa chen pos dpar gyi 'du byed du bskrun nas skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la spel ba po ni/ gdan rabs bcu gcig pa 7grub dbang sku phreng gnyis pa'i yang srid thub bstan bshad sgrub chos kyi sgra dbyangs nyid yin cing*/ de'ang rdzogs sprul lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje'i lung bstan las/ gnas mchog spu bo stod kyi phyogs shig na// rin chen brag ri lhun sdug mjes pa'i rtsar// ljon shing sna tshogs mtsho dang lding kas brgyan// bsil ldan chu bo chen po lho nas 'dren// thabs shes bsod nams skyid kyi ming can la// rigs ldan khye'u chu sprel lo pa 'byung*// bstan 'gror sman pa'i dge mtshan bzang po shar// rdzogs sprul lnga pa chos kyi rdo rjes spel// zhes (8)gsungs pa ltar/ khrag 'thung bdud 'dul rdo rje'i gdung rigs yab bsod nams 'gyur med dang*/ yum 'dzoms skyid gnyis kyi sras su/ rab rgyal chu sprel lor rgyal zla ba'i tshes bzang por sku'i dkyil 'khor gsar du bzhad cing*/ mkhan chen ngag gi dbang po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis kyang grub dbang dpal chen 'dus pa'i yang srid de kho nar ltar yin pa'i dbugs dbyung gnang*/ me khyi lor gdan sar spyan drangs/ mkhan chen ngag gi dbang po la gtsug phud phul/ mchog sprul rin po che'i mdun nas skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan 7thub bstan legs bshad chos kyi sgra dbyangs gsol/ brda gor gnam chos rdzogs chen sangs rgyas lag 'chang gi sngon 'gro sogs gsan sbyangs mdzad cing*/ rin chen gter mdzod bka' brgya dang bcas pa smin grol yongs rdzogs gnang*/ gnam chos/ rat+na'i chos skor/ bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs dgongs 'dus sogs sgrub dbang dang 'brel ba gsan/

dgung grangs bcu gsum thog mkhan po mchog sprul rin po che thub bstan chos kyi zla ba dang las (9)slob kaḥthog mkhan legs bshad 'byor ldan/ gsang ston pa mkhan chen mkhyen brtse 'od zer/ grogs dan pa rtsam mdo ha 'ja' mkhan po bsod nams don grub/ kha skong ba shug sgang hor shul pad+ma 'jigs med bcas dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i mdun nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan 7'jigs med thub bstan bshad sgrub chos kyi sgra dbyangs zhes gsol*/ phyis dar thang dgon du lo mang bzhugs skabs mkhan po de nyid las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes shing rim pas mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas par gsan bsam sgom pa gnang*/ khyad par mkhan legs bshad 'byor ldan nas 'dus mdo'i dbang chog sbrang rtsi'i chu rgyun dang*/ gdams mdzod sogs dang*/ mkhan chen mkhyen brtse 'od zer gyi brda go'i yang khrod du gsar brtsom gnang ba'i mdo 'grel chen mo pod bzhi can/ gnubs kyi mdo 'grel mun pa'i go cha/(10)chos rje dam pa'i khog dbub/ sa bcad stong thun skor bcas sbrags nas/ grub dbang yang srid rin po che dang*/ mchog sprul 'jam blo/ mchog sprul thub bstan dpal bzang*/ zhe chen mkhan sgra dbyangs/ mkhan mgon grub lnga la 'dus mdo'i sgrub pa dang 'grel ba'i ljags bshad khrid lung gi tshul du zhag zhe brgyad bar gsan sbyangs chos sgo'i thog mar gnang bas snga 'gyur 'dus pa mdo'i bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa'i phrin las 'gran zla dang bral bar gyur/ rgya gar gyi yul du snga 'gyur theg mchog rnam grol bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling gi chos sde gsar du btab cing*/ rgyal bstan rin po che bshad sgrub gnyis kyis sgo nas 'dzin skyong spel ba'i phrin las nyin byed dbang pos 'dzam gling snang bar byed cing zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor g.yo med rdo rje'i rang khams su bzhugs bzhin pa'o/

slar smras pa/ 'dir 'bad rnam thar nyin byed gzhon nu yis// dad ldan blo yi pad+mo kha 'byed cing*// thos bsam sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis rab dub te/ (11)grub pa'i dga' tshal rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces 7grub dbang rin po che sku phreng rim byon gyi rnam thar gdan rabs las gsal ba rnams nyung ngur phyogs gcig tu bsdus te sku phreng gnyis pa'i gsung 'bum dpar bskrun gyi dbur 'jog ched rab rgyal chu khams 'khor lo'i sna can gyi lor shākya'i dge slong pad+ma shes rab kyis bsgrigs pa'o/// /
